$comment: What a token set can do for each of the 33 Conduction component tokens, measured on the inventory (scripts/mapping/internal-tokens.json) and proved by tests/vitest/conductionTokenReach.spec.js.

follows: the library's own value reads a Nextcloud variable that css/systems/nldesign/theme.css maps from the set token named as driver, so the component already wears the set and a declaration would change nothing. variants: the library declares the variable on more than one selector (success, warning, error), and one set-level value would replace all of them, so no shipped stylesheet may declare it.

literal: the library's own value is a size, a weight or a ratio. The --nldesign-* vocabulary holds no spacing or type scale, so a set has no value of its own to give; an administrator can still set the token.
use-site: the library declares the variable nowhere and reads it with a fallback where it is used. The note says what that fallback is.

--nldesign-cn-email-accent.note: The unread dot of the email tab. Read as var(--cn-email-accent, var(--color-primary-element)), so unset it wears the primary colour of the set.

--nldesign-cn-forms-accent.note: The row icon of the Forms tab. Read with the fixed green #0d7000 of the Forms app as its fallback, which follows no set and measures 2.85:1 on a #171717 dark background.

--nldesign-cn-kpi-value-text-size.note: A KPI value shown as text instead of a number. Read with 1.25rem as its fallback.

--nldesign-cn-sidebar-tab-min-width.note: The narrowest a sidebar tab may be. Read with 7rem as its fallback.

--nldesign-cn-spacing-m.note: The padding of an object list widget. Read with 12px as its fallback.

--nldesign-cn-table-cell-max-width.note: The widest a table cell may grow. Read with 22rem as its fallback.

--nldesign-cn-xwiki-accent.note: The row icon of the XWiki tab. Read with the fixed green #3CA22F of XWiki as its fallback, which follows no set and measures 3.28:1 on white.

--nldesign-cn-xwiki-accent-soft.note: The tint behind the XWiki row icon. Read with rgba(60, 162, 47, 0.12) as its fallback, which follows no set.
